theme: An open day in St. Pete — clear the Croatia bookings before the window shuts.
greeting: The calendar is empty today, Dan, so the day is yours — and the overdue Croatia bookings are what it is best spent on. The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, and tomorrow noon brings the Valoris call with Martin.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat hotel and transfer for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The last night of the Croatia trip is still unbooked: Cavtat near the airport, one night Sat Sept 19, plus the noon transfer from ACI Komolac. It has to be locked from land before you sail on Sept 8, and it has sat open since Aug 23.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on both Eurowings Discover legs. Pull it up on the operating carrier's site by record locator and buy the bags now — two 55L duffels get refused at the gate otherwise.

needsAttention.title: Close the St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: The two nights in St. Pete after you land TPA on Sept 20, before the Sept 22 pickup, are still open. While you are at it, check that the Sept 27–Oct 5 Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Bring a country view to the Valoris call
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at noon you are back with Martin Steindl to continue the Valoris conversation. Arrive holding your take on Davit's Priority One country list and where you would want to focus.

flagged.title: Nautilus final sailing-course payment due
flagged.detail: Invoice 2170 from Nautilus shows a $6,475 balance due ahead of the September charter.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and receipts — a Chase statement (auto-pay is on), Todoist digests, and language-app and shopping mail.

recipe.title: Sautéed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means zucchini and basil are everywhere — a quick sauté keeps the kitchen cool.

tasks.title: Passport packet for the four girls (Mike's to assemble)

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the clear morning is the time to knock out the overdue Croatia bookings.
Still open all afternoon, room to sort the flight bags and the St. Pete gap before tomorrow's call.
The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete — an easy evening, with the Valoris call to think through for the morning.
